description: Under policy.yaml devices.revocation end_logins (the default, also when absent) a revocation ends every login tied to the device at once: its cookie is refused (401) from then on, its vault unlock purged, its tickets voided, its alert streams ended, and its attached clients closed with 4015 device_revoked, which forbids auto-reattach; the terminal sessions live on (credential-protection §10.2). The revoking principal's own other logins are untouched. Graded through a fresh login tied to the device.
